name: Dakota Marketplace MCP Server
description: Enables AI clients to query Dakota Marketplace data by integrating directly with Salesforce via OAuth and PKCE. Users can search and retrieve detailed profiles for fund managers, allocators, and funds while maintaining native Salesforce security and sharing rules.
